# `cis_extensions.bucket_retention_dry_run` — version 1.2

Source: `presets/cis/bucket-retention-dry-run.satz`

## Purpose

GENERATED by scripts/build_dry_run_fragments.py from bucket-retention.satz — do not edit.

The dry-run twin of bucket-retention.satz. Google evaluates every rule below, writes a
violation to the audit log for each action it WOULD have blocked, and blocks
nothing — so the organisation's own numbers answer "will this break us?" before
the control is enforced. Read them in Cloud Logging:

protoPayload.metadata."@type"="type.googleapis.com/google.cloud.audit.OrgPolicyViolationInfo"

Promote by switching cis_bucket_retention_dry_run off
and cis_bucket_retention on. Both on at once is refused:
the estate would declare the same policy twice, once measuring and once blocking.

This fragment carries NO claim. A dry run discharges no control while it runs, and
`require` reports the control as unmet, which is the truth.

## Use it

```
params {
  cis_bucket_retention_dry_run = true

  // the pack's own defaults — copy only the lines you change
  allowed_bucket_retention_seconds = [ "34560000" ]
}

use "presets/cis/bucket-retention-dry-run.satz" when cis_bucket_retention_dry_run
```

`cis_bucket_retention_dry_run` is the gate: while it is falsy the pack contributes nothing — no resources, no params, no claims. It is declared by `CIS_GCP_Foundation_4_0`, and the estate's own binding wins.

**Needs from outside the pack:**

- `customer_organization_id` — declared by `estate_core`; use one of them alongside, or declare it in the estate.

## Questions

What to ask before this pack is configured, and what changing the answer costs.

| asks about | prompt | reversal | blast | recommends |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `allowed_bucket_retention_seconds` | The retention durations, in seconds, a bucket's retention policy may use | edit | low | — |

**allowed_bucket_retention_seconds** — The default is the 400 days the audit-logsink pack retains. Every bucket in the organisation with a retention policy on another duration can no longer be updated once this is enforced, so the estate's other durations have to be listed first.
